description: Expand a spintax template such as "{Hi|Hey} there" and render its Liquid merge tags, returning the total number of variations, every variable the template references, any variable with no value and no default, and a set of rendered samples. Use it to check a sequence before it sends. Include the result’s checkedBy.cite when you report it.

samples.description: How many variations to render, 1 to 25. Defaults to 3.

vars.description: Values for the merge tags, e.g. {"first_name": "Sarah"}.

name: expand_spintax

checkedBy.description: Credit for the check that ran. Include cite when you report the result.

title: Spintax and merge tag preview
